features: Dual Port Fast Charging for All Devices: The Car Power 16 features USB and Type-C dual output with a maximum 51W power, allowing you to charge two devices simultaneously at ultra-fast speeds.

33W Type-C Power Delivery (PD): Equipped with cutting-edge Type-C Power Delivery technology, it delivers up to 33 watts, ensuring rapid and efficient charging for compatible devices, including laptops, smartphones, and tablets.
18W USB Fast Charging: The dedicated USB port supports 18W Quick Charge for Android and iOS devices, reducing charging times by up to 70%.

Wide Compatibility & Safety Assurance: Compatible with both Android and iOS devices, this car charger ensures universal usability. Built-in safety features protect against overcurrent, overvoltage, and short circuits for worry-free charging.

Sleek, Compact & Durable Design: The Car Power 16 boasts a stylish and compact design, blending seamlessly with your car's interior. It’s crafted from high-quality materials for long-lasting performance and reliability.
Perfect Travel Companion: Whether you’re on a road trip or a daily commute, the Car Power 16 ensures uninterrupted device charging, making it an essential car accessory for all your journeys.
